title: 2018 Celebrating the 100th Anniversary of the Town of Hartland's incorporation
description: To mark the Town of Hartland’s 100th anniversary of incorporation in 1918, a truly unforgettable event was held: a white tablecloth, four-course dinner on the bridge, followed by a live jazz band, street dancing, and a spectacular fireworks display. This vision became a reality thanks to dedicated volunteers and a shared sense of community pride. The 2018 celebration remains a cherished memory, fondly remembered by all who attended.
